title: Advancing Integrated Cryo-Fluorescence Imaging for Fast, Reliable and High Throughput Cryo-ET Lamella Production
content: Correlative cryo-FIB milling is a powerful sample preparation technique for in situ cryo electron tomography (cryo-ET). Using this technique, vitrified cells can be thinned down and cellular components can be directly visualized in their native context at near-atomic resolution. In recent years several solutions have been proposed to simplify the technique by integrating fluorescent microscopes in the cryo-FIB [1-4]. However, it remains challenging to accurately target the region of interest (ROI) while maintaining a high throughput workflow. Here we present a novel version of Delmic’s high-quality integrated fluorescent microscope, called METEOR 2.0, designed to sustain high throughput while enabling precise targeting of the ROI.
